brief:
Fifty-three nations and organisations called on Israel Thursday to permit urgent aid deliveries and unimpeded humanitarian access into Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The statement came as Gaza faced a severe humanitarian crisis.

The collective appeal represented a coordinated diplomatic push by a broad coalition of countries and aid groups seeking to pressure Israel on its control of aid flows into the besieged enclave.
dek: Watch: 53 nations and organisations urge Israel to allow aid into Gaza Fifty-three nations and organisations urged Israel on Thursday to allow urgent aid and unimpeded humanitarian access into Gaza.
title: Fifty-three nations urge Israel to open Gaza to aid
